name: Inversiones La Construcción S.A.
summary: Inversiones La Construcción S.A. operates in the financial and health sectors in Chile, Peru, and Colombia. It operates through six segments: AFP, Ispare, Insurance, Health, Banking, and Other segments. The company is involved in the management of products related to savings and retirement, including mandatory individual retirement savings; individual and group voluntary retirement savings; voluntary individual savings; management and payment of pensions under scheduled or temporary withdrawal programs through a network of branches and digital platforms, such as websites, call centers, and mobile applications; and provision of health insurance solutions, plans, and supplementary products and…
